listing.summary: Adds a fleet of Draconis ships focused on flux capacity and speed for rapid strike doctrines.

description:
Quote

"Yesterday, without warning, without grievance beyond their own manufactured envy, Athebyne struck our people in the dark. I will not stand before you and call this war - I will call it what it is: murder dressed in a flag. But I will tell you this, and I will mean every word: we will answer this butchery with everything Itoron has ever built, and we will answer it until no convoy, no worker, no citizen of this world need ever again look to the stars and wonder if today is the day they burn."
— Director-General Samuel J. Harrows, address to the Combined Legislature, c176

// Overview:

Draconis ships are built around flux capacity and speed over armor and shields. Doctrine revolves around rapid strikes with concentrated firepower followed by disengagement before combat readiness collapses. The ships excel in this role but struggle outside of it - catch one in a 1 vs Many engagement, and the thin protection quickly becomes a liability. Ballistics and missiles are the weapons of choice; the fleet is not built for prolonged flux wars so most energy weapons are tuned for high damage high flux.

// History:

The Draconis Defense Alliance is a stratocracy governing the Fafnir system - a state of emergency declared at the end of a brutal civil war and never rescinded. Fleet Admiral Emil August, who shattered the rebel world of Athebyne with seventy-two hours of orbital bombardment, has ruled by consolidated military authority ever since. The Alliance's independence is maintained through geographic isolation, a doctrine of total resistance, and arrangements with outside powers that neither party publicly acknowledges.

Requires LazyLib, GraphicsLib and MagicLib

Supports: Nexerelin, Combat Chatter, AdvancedGunneryControl and Commissioned Crews

Known Issues:

None, yet.
